verdict.rationale: Summer Engine's own marketing says it makes "real 2D and 3D games" in a full engine with physics, so 2D is a claimed first-party workflow. Nothing documents sprites, tilemaps or 2D-specific physics, and nothing shows 2D is first-class rather than secondary to 3D. missing for 10: sprite tooling documentation, tilemap editor/support, explicit 2D physics system, evidence 2D is first-class rather than a 3D afterthought, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, 2D is a first-class workflow — sprites, tilemaps, 2D physics — not a 3D afterthought

citations.quote: Make real 2D and 3D games with Summer Engine
Summer builds it with you in a full engine: 2D and 3D, physics, animation and real gameplay
